links.outcome: Membership inference leakage of patient records from fine-tuned clinical LLM using loss-based and paraphrase-based attacks
links.effect: Limited but measurable membership leakage; the clinical LLM showed partial resistance but remained susceptible to subtle privacy risks. No numeric results reported in the text.
links.quote: Our preliminary findings reveal limited but measurable membership leakage, suggesting that current clinical LLMs provide partial resistance yet remain susceptible to subtle privacy risks that could undermine trust in clinical AI adoption.

unlisted_practices: Paraphrase-based perturbation membership inference attack as a domain-motivated privacy evaluation of clinical LLMs

screen.reason: Empirically tests membership inference privacy vulnerabilities in a clinical LLM (Llemr) fine-tuned on EHR data without testing a specific deployment guardrail intervention.
